relations.subject: Lydia Aran
relations.evidence: Lydia Aran (Hebrew: לידיה ארן; October 1921 – March 5, 2013 in Jerusalem), was a professor emerita at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem

relations.subject: Lydia Aran
relations.object: Hebrew University's Department of Indian Studies
